projectDesc.p: Every non-wrapper retained HTML content unit is projected exactly once and bound by source ID. Project Gutenberg header and license wrappers are retained separately and excluded from the candidate text. No print pagination or omitted formula is reconstructed.

The electronic edition documents added dedication, contents, prologues, question and article numbering; Latin-referenced and transcription corrections; absent print pagination and headers; omitted repetitive article formula; normalized Bible citation numerals; inline bracketed print footnotes; transliterated Greek; and altered emphasis and quotation conventions.
